mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.images, r.duration_days, r.budget, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.images, r.duration_days, r.budget, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.status, r.create_time, uc.id AS comment_id, uc.user_id AS comment_user_id, uc.content AS comment_content, uc.create_time AS comment_create_time, u.username AS comment_username, u.avatar AS comment_avatar FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN user_comment uc ON r.id = uc.target_id AND uc.type = 2 AND uc.is_audit = 1 LEFT JOIN user u ON uc.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.images, r.duration_days, r.budget, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.images, r.duration_days, r.budget, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.status, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id WHERE r.category_id = #{categoryId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
